Package eu.cloudhopper.mc.annotations

Annotation Interface Bucket

@Retention(SOURCE) @Target(PARAMETER) public @interface Bucket
Binds a BlobStore parameter to a storage bucket the function reads or writes.

The generator creates the bucket once per name, or uses the bucket that an @EventTrigger(source = STORAGE, name = ...) of the same project creates. It grants the function's identity exactly the declared access() and passes the bucket's name to the runtime. A bucket owned by another system is declared with existing = true.


 @Function(name = "priceList")
 @HttpTrigger(path = "/prices", method = "GET")
 public String prices(@Bucket(name = "pricing") BlobStore store) {
     return store.get("prices.json").map(String::new).orElse("[]");
 }

 @Function(name = "updatePrices")
 @ScheduledTrigger(cron = "0 4 * * *")
 public void update(@Bucket(name = "pricing", access = Access.READ_WRITE) BlobStore store) {
     store.put("prices.json", fetchPrices(), "application/json");
 }

  • Element Details

    • name

      String name
      The name of the bucket, as in @EventTrigger(source = STORAGE, name = ...).

      Use 3 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, starting with a letter. The deployment adds its name prefix, as for the buckets of storage triggers.

      Returns:
      the bucket name

    • access

      Bucket.Access access
      What the function may do with the bucket; the default is reading only.
      Returns:

    • existing

      boolean existing
